A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Arg-LLaDA study, with readable text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices. Appendix A contains only a heading in both versions; Appendix B contains the same zero-shot prompt. The supplied material supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original ASE and ArgKP benchmark results in Table 2, human evaluations in Figure 2, and refinement and sufficiency-module ablations in Table 3.

after.justification: V2 retains the original benchmark and human-evaluation results, with the ablations presented separately in Tables 3 and 4.

M1.justification: V1's masking rule combines token insufficiency with uniform exploration noise. V2 Section 3.3 replaces it with weighted token-confidence and span-sufficiency signals and introduces confidence-threshold and lowest-r token selection. This substantially revises the reported central inference procedure, while retaining the diffusion backbone, training loss, and classifier architecture.

E1.justification: Both versions use ASE and ArgKP for the same argument-summarization task. No additional dataset, domain, population, or test scenario is reported in the main text or appendices.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the same zero-shot and fine-tuned comparator rows. Figure 2 also retains its original human-evaluation comparator set; no evaluated baseline is added or removed.

E3.justification: Section 4's experimental setup is unchanged, including the ArgKP 28:3 split, automatic metrics, and three-annotator five-point evaluation. The 30% training masking ratio, batch size, and optimization settings are also retained. Newly specified span granularity documents implementation rather than establishing a revised evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: The same zero-to-three-step refinement analysis and No Diagnosis, CoT Only, Classifier Only, and Combine comparisons remain. V1 Table 3 is split into v2 Tables 3 and 4 without adding analyses or testing the revised confidence component separately.

E5.justification: The descriptions of averaging human ratings and assessing Krippendorff's alpha are unchanged. V2 adds no repeated-run counts, seeds, uncertainty intervals, numerical agreement estimates, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All benchmark values, ablation entries, and human-evaluation plot data are retained. For example, Arg-LLaDA's ArgKP ROUGE-L/BLEURT/BERTScore remain 0.453/0.658/0.834, and its reported coverage/faithfulness/conciseness ratings remain 4.7/4.6/4.4.

T1.justification: Equation 5 substantively changes the mathematical masking distribution from insufficiency plus uniform noise to confidence deficit plus weighted span insufficiency. The task objective, denoising loss, and classifier equation remain equivalent. Removing v1 Equation 6 removes a duplicate reverse-process equation, not distinct theory.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same novelty and superiority claims, including the abstract's claim of leading on seven of ten metrics and the claimed human-evaluation gains. V2 does not redefine the main contributions.

C2.justification: V2 explains the complementary roles of confidence and sufficiency, including why confidence alone misses confidently incorrect content or omissions. It also adds a specific caveat that CoT judgments depend on model scale and prompting quality. The results interpretations and standalone Limitations section remain unchanged.

D1.justification: V2 newly specifies sentence segmentation using punctuation and discourse boundaries, clause splitting, and projection of span scores onto tokens. Section 3.5 also explicitly mentions omissions among synthetic perturbations, without establishing a changed training pipeline. Hardware, optimization details, and Appendix B's prompt are retained; Appendix A remains empty.

R1.justification: The Gonzalez et al. (2023) SEEDS citation and reference are removed. The revised inference discussion cites the already-present Nie et al. (2025). The related-work section and broader research positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: V2 reorganizes the methodology into a dedicated inference-masking subsection, rewrites the masking and diagnosis explanations, renumbers subsequent subsections, and removes a redundant reverse-process description. These are localized revisions; the surrounding narrative and appendix text remain stable.

P2.justification: V1's two-panel Table 3 becomes separate Tables 3 and 4 with individual captions and placements. Figure 2 and appendix headings shift with text reflow. The underlying figures, benchmark-table structure, and displayed results are retained.

improvement.justification: V2 improves method transparency through explicit span segmentation, score projection, clearer separation of confidence and sufficiency, and a concrete prompting-variability caveat. These are limited specification and exposition gains: the unchanged experiments do not isolate the benefit of the revised masking rule, its threshold and weighting values remain unspecified, and Appendix A still lacks processing details.
